motivation.interpretation: Long-horizon and high-power underprediction dominate squared error and therefore depress RMSE, R2 and RMSE skill.

decision_rule.pilot_success: The selected checkpoint must improve both MAE and RMSE over the paired trend baseline and increase R2 without a material regression in any reported metric.
decision_rule.pilot_failure: Any material MAE regression, no RMSE/R2 improvement, or provenance mismatch.
decision_rule.expansion: Only after pilot success, freeze the exact objective and run the predeclared remaining folds and seeds.

locked_rules: Do not tune the objective weights on the sealed test split.
Do not change data cleaning, folds, seed, architecture or pretraining in the pilot.
Do not compare against Persistence alone; retain paired trend and frozen strong baselines.
Do not claim significance from the single-fold development pilot.
